bergmann_2026.interpretation: Region-specific mapping strongly beats one global affine mapping. This rejects a single global scalar response map for these processed KC calcium means; it does not directly measure a synaptic delta or temporal hidden state.

sun_2025_figure4j_author_processed.interpretation: The author-processed neural-population representation separates in shared sensory segments. A deterministic state that depends only on the current shared observation cannot produce context-specific representations. This supports history/context state, but not a particular K.

decision.next_required_test: Use longitudinal cell/synapse time-series; freeze K and tau grid before held-out animals/sessions; compare K=1 vs K>1 at equal effective parameter budget and require held-out improvement plus shuffled-history control.
